title: Search results page
evidence: the listing alone or with the subscription on about half the search pages, with a banner too on about a quarter; the listing is a child copy of the category listing on about 4 in 5

steps.note: Usually a child copy of the category listing: edit the category listing, and tell the user that search changes with it.

The store-wide subscription keeps the preset chosen on home: `section set` restyles it on every page. Only where it already sits on this page: `section add` makes an independent copy, not the shared one.

notes: Promo banners over search results are optional: the visitor already knows what they want.
